ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A practice offers comprehensive legal counsel across a wide range of corporate and transactional matters, including general corporate law, incorporation, governance, restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, corporate and project finance, capital markets, real estate transactions, infrastructure, construction, domestic and international contracts, distribution agreements, foreign investment, exchange control, compliance, fintech, and e-commerce.

As a leading firm in Venezuela, ARAQUEREYNA has a strong track record of successfully advising clients on complex corporate and M&A transactions. Our team excels in navigating the complex legal landscape in Venezuela, conducting thorough due diligence investigations, structuring, negotiating, and closing deals efficiently, and ensuring compliance with US sanctions and local regulations.

We work closely with our Banking, Tax, and Compliance teams to provide comprehensive solutions tailored to our clients’ specific needs.

ARAQUEREYNA stands out among our peers for innovating in the sector and for our ability to adapt to change. A distinguished example for that is ARAQUEREYNA WithU (HYPERLINK "https://mailchi.mp/acc861a2cc48/emprendedores"https://mailchi.mp/acc861a2cc48/emprendedores). A project that offers legal kits and preferential rates to startups, entrepreneurs and new businesses. The goal is for entrepreneurs to have access to top legal assistance, for their new businesses, by one of the most recognized law firms in Venezuela. Corporate law is one of the practice areas included in ARAQUEREYNA WithU for its relevance on any startup’s success.

We are also promoting Widu Legal (HYPERLINK "https://widulegal.com/"https://widulegal.com/), an online platform for legal documents. This project, which was born in our firm, has managed to expand to eight countries in Latin America, positioning ARAQUEREYNA in the Legal Tech sector.

Providing better services to our clients has been made possible by our continuous and active participation in important business associations and chambers, such as The Venezuelan American Chamber of Commerce and Industry (VENAMCHAM), The Caracas Chamber of Commerce, Industry and Services (Cámara de Caracas), Venezuelan Colombian Economic Integration Chamber (CAVECOL), British Venezuelan Chamber of Commerce (BRITCHAM), Venezuelan Chamber of Construction (CVC) and others.

Juan José Figueroa is an expert in corporate structuring, mergers, acquisitions and restructuring. His strategic approach and ability to resolve complex issues make him a benchmark in corporate counselling, helping clients navigate a challenging legal environment with practical and effective solutions.

Federica Mena, whose practice focuses on mergers and acquisitions, corporate restructurings, real estate and the sanctions regime, is also the General Coordinator of ARAQUEREYNA WithU (mentioned above). Her practical approach and commitment to her clients reinforce her position as a leading practitioner among her peers in the corporate sector.

Both reflect ARAQUEREYNA's commitment to excellence and innovation in the corporate sector, providing comprehensive advice and outstanding results, which is why we firmly believe that both should be ranked in next year’s guide.

ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department acted as legal counsel in a negotiation on behalf of the Spanish company Dragados, S.A. with the Attorney General's Office of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in relation to an advance payment made to Dragados in 1999 for the construction of the "Las Palmas" dam in the state of Cojedes in Venezuela. The Venezuelan government tacitly withdrew from the contract.  As a result of the withdrawal, the Republic of Venezuela was obliged to pay Dragados 16% of the value of the contract (US$60,000,000.00) under Venezuela's general rules on government contracts.
However, the Republic of Venezuela brought an action against Dragados before the Venezuelan Supreme Court, arguing that the contract provided for the jurisdiction of the Venezuelan courts under Venezuelan law. On the other hand, Dragados S.A. filed a lawsuit against the Republic of Venezuela in the courts of Madrid on the grounds of "forum non-conveniens" before the lawsuit was filed in Venezuela.
ARAQUEREYNA's involvement consisted of negotiating and implementing a solution to the situation and designing a mechanism for compliance with the agreements with the Attorney General of the Republic, which led to the signing of a settlement agreement that put an end to the entire dispute. To implement the settlement, it was necessary to design and carry out transfers and banking operations for currency exchange, payment and the execution of the final contract, with the necessary waivers and settlements, both in the Courts of Madrid, Spain, and in the Supreme Court of Venezuela.

The department’s stated role covered all legal aspects of the acquisition and operational set-up. This is a direct Corporate/M&A mandate with cross-border and regulated-product features; the transaction value is confidential.
matters.rationale: Strongest completed, direct acquisition in the record: it identifies buyer, seller, asset, cross-border jurisdictions, a broad legal role and continuing post-closing implementation. It makes a stronger hero than Corporación de Aceros Arequipa because completion of the acquisition is express and the local execution work is described.
matters.source_quote: Through a joint work, coordinated by Andrea Di Dio, of DLA Piper Italy, ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department advised Gruppo Montenegro (a leading Italian Food and Spirits manufacturer) on all the legal aspects related to the acquisition of the Venezuelan rum brand Pampero from Diageo and on the operation, production, commercialisation, and distribution of such brand in Venezuela, which enjoys the attributes and protection of the Denomination of Controlled Origin “Ron de Venezuela.”

matters.legal_understanding: Cross-border due diligence and bidding work for the direct acquisition of 80% of Bekaert Ideal S.L. and indirect acquisition of shares in companies in Costa Rica, Ecuador, Venezuela and Colombia. The firm analysed corporate, contractual, insurance, real-estate, labour and regulatory matters, including a Venezuelan subsidiary then merging with another company. This is a direct Corporate/M&A acquisition mandate. The record gives August 2024 as the date but does not expressly confirm that the acquisition closed; value is confidential.
matters.rationale: One of the strongest mandates because it concerns an 80% acquisition across five jurisdictions, a multi-disciplinary diligence scope and a Venezuelan merger-related complication. It ranks below Gruppo Montenegro (Montenegro S.r.l.) because the source does not expressly state completion or the firm’s role beyond diligence and bidding.
matters.source_quote:
ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A Department assisted the client in the due diligence and bidding process for the direct acquisition of 80% of the shares issued by Bekaert Ideal S.L. and the indirect acquisition of shares in companies located in Costa Rica, Ecuador, Venezuela and Colombia. We analyse corporate, contractual, insurance, real estate, labour and regulatory aspects.

In the case of the Venezuelan company, the corporate aspects were particularly relevant because, at the time of the bid, the Venezuelan subsidiary was in the process of merging with another company.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing Spain–Venezuela corporate downsizing and divestment programme for Dragados and its Venezuelan subsidiary. The stated work includes completed liquidation of consortia and due diligence, negotiation, execution and SPA drafting for sales of stakes in two Venezuelan companies. This is a direct Corporate/M&A disposal and restructuring mandate; the value is confidential.
matters.rationale: High-value editorial contribution through multiple completed corporate liquidations and two stake sales, with a clearly described transactional role and cross-border client context. It is selected ahead of smaller governance or market-entry mandates despite the overall programme remaining ongoing.
matters.source_quote:
During 2024, we successfully closed and liquidated several significant consortia in which DYCVENSA was a member, previously involved in major infrastructure projects nationwide.

We also conducted due diligence, negotiated, and executed the sale of Dragados’ stakes in two prominent Venezuelan companies in the construction and services sectors. We assisted with sale negotiations, execution and the drafting of Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs).

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic sale process for a Venezuelan agricultural securities firm, pending approval from SUNAVAL. The Corporate/M&A team prepared sale materials, negotiated the SPA and oversaw escrow of the purchase price. This is a direct regulated-sector M&A sale mandate. Regulatory approval remains pending, so no completed sale should be claimed; value is confidential.
matters.rationale: A strong, clearly delineated regulated M&A sale with specific transaction-documentation and escrow responsibilities. It is selected despite its pending status because the legal work and outstanding approval are both clearly evidenced.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A team assisted Bursagro Casa de Bolsa Agrícola, C.A. (Bursagro) in preparing the sale materials, negotiating the Share Purchase Agreement (SPA), and overseeing the escrow of the purchase price, while awaiting regulatory approval from the Venezuelan Securities Regulator (SUNAVAL) for the sale of Bursagro, a Venezuelan securities firm specializing in agricultural products.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic equity restructuring of Empresas PMC involving capitalisation rights in a CEPSA subsidiary for five years, described as US$14 million plus a 10% annual premium on the nominal value of the rights. The firm’s role is stated as participating in the restructuring and analysing commercial and tax aspects with multiple departments. It is a direct Corporate/M&A capital restructuring, with a tax component. The amount is described in the narrative while the matter-value field is confidential; it should remain confidential in any external use.
matters.rationale: Strong core matter because it provides a defined equity-restructuring mechanism, stated financial magnitude and cross-practice analysis. The source does not specify the firm’s precise responsibility for the issuance or allocation mechanics, so leadership should not be overstated.
matters.source_quote:
ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department is participating in the equity restructuring of Empresas PMC, C.A., which involves the issue of capitalisation rights in a wholly owned subsidiary of Central El Palmar, S.A. (CEPSA) for a period of five years for US$14 million, plus a premium on the shares to be issued equivalent to 10% per annum of the nominal value of the capitalisation rights.

This restructuring involves an interesting process of allocation of the capitalisation rights associated with the issue. The commercial and tax aspects of the transaction had to be analysed with the active participation of lawyers and partners from different departments of ARAQUEREYNA.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic corporate restructuring, governance and debt-financing mandate for SANU Corp and HAS. The team is negotiating agreements, facilitating debt financing and developing internal governance policies with the shareholders and CEO. It has a direct Corporate/M&A nexus through restructuring and governance, with a Banking & Finance component in the debt arrangements. No completed result is stated and value is confidential.
matters.rationale: A substantive restructuring mandate combining shareholder-level negotiations, governance work and financing arrangements. It is stronger than routine governance matters because the source specifies several connected legal workstreams, though the financing remains ongoing.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department is currently advising SANU Corp and HAS, certified Type B companies, a leading provider of food services to non-profit organizations and schools across Venezuela, on a significant corporate restructuring and financing initiative. Our team is collaborating closely with the company's shareholders and CEO, Luis Medina, to negotiate critical agreements and facilitate debt financing arrangements. Additionally, the team has been instrumental in developing internal corporate governance policies

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing cross-border market-entry and commercial-structuring mandate for a payment intermediary. The work includes regulatory opinions on fintech, tax, banking and sanctions matters; establishment of banking relationships; structuring and negotiation of import/export transactions; and supporting contracts. The Corporate/M&A nexus is market entry, strategic banking partnerships and transactional/commercial structuring, while its regulatory and banking elements are mixed-practice components. No value is supplied beyond confidentiality.
matters.rationale: The mandate evidences cross-border corporate expansion, institutional-bank engagement and negotiated commercial transactions. It is selected for sector diversity and direct market-entry work, although the record does not identify a discrete acquisition or completed transaction.
matters.source_quote: Working closely with SUMMUS, we facilitated strategic partnerships with major Venezuelan banks, culminating in the establishment of a premier banking relationship with Banco Activo. Our team played a key role in structuring and negotiating numerous export and import transactions, particularly between Colombia and Venezuela, ensuring compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. We also drafted and negotiated key contracts to support the operations of SUMMUS.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic company-formation and shareholder-governance mandate for aircraft management. The work includes negotiating arrangements for creation of the company and a private shareholders’ agreement addressing capital changes, management, aircraft use and compulsory purchase/sale exit regimes. This is a direct Corporate/M&A governance and joint-ownership structuring mandate. No value or completed outcome is stated.
matters.rationale: Selected because the source specifies substantive governance terms—capital, management and exit mechanics—rather than generic incorporation. It is a stronger corporate-formation example than BDO Colombia, though it lacks a cross-border element, value and confirmed closing.
matters.source_quote: The service includes a private shareholders' agreement, with particular attention to the issue of capital increases or decreases, the management regime of the company and the use of the aircraft, as well as the regime for the exit of partners with mandatory share purchase or sale regimes.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing US-facing corporate structuring mandate for IESA, involving design of a corporate structure for registration with US authorities, contract analysis and an assessment under the US sanctions regime. The Corporate/M&A nexus is international corporate establishment/structuring; sanctions analysis is an integrated regulatory component. The source does not identify a completed registration or transaction value.
matters.rationale: Selected because it combines outbound corporate structuring with a stated US sanctions analysis, adding a differentiated cross-border regulatory dimension. It remains an ongoing mandate and should not be presented as a completed US establishment.
matters.source_quote:
ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department assisted IESA in 2024 with the design of a corporate structure for registration with the relevant authorities in the United States of America to operate, as well as the analysis of various contracts.

The team also assessed the legality of the transaction under the US sanctions regime.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing cross-border corporate internationalisation mandate for IESA and its subsidiaries, involving structural design for operations in Panama, Barbados and the Dominican Republic, as well as strategic-alliance agreements with global institutions. The work also includes opinions on the new Non-Profit Organizations Law. The Corporate/M&A nexus is international corporate structuring and alliance documentation; nonprofit-law advice is an adjacent regulatory component. No transaction value or completed outcome is stated.
matters.rationale: Selected as evidence of multi-jurisdictional corporate structuring and strategic-alliance work. It adds nonprofit/institutional-client diversity, but its importance and transaction value are not quantified.
matters.source_quote: Additionally, our team has been instrumental in evaluating and designing the structural framework for IESA's internationalization efforts, including its subsidiaries, Fundación de Estudios Avanzados de Gerencia (FEAG), in Panama, Barbados, and the Dominican Republic. We have also assisted IESA's Development Management Unit in negotiating and drafting agreements for strategic alliances with global institutions.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing Colombia–Venezuela market-entry mandate for BDO Colombia involving Venezuelan entity structuring, incorporation, shareholder-agreement negotiation and completion of the steps required for establishment. It is a direct Corporate/M&A corporate formation and governance mandate. The source says all establishment steps were completed this year, while the matter is still marked ongoing; the remaining work is unspecified. Value is confidential.
matters.rationale: Selected for evidenced cross-border entry, entity design and negotiated shareholder arrangements. The matter is less significant than acquisition, disposal and financing matters, and its ongoing status should be retained alongside the stated completion of establishment steps.
matters.source_quote: Additionally, we advise on the negotiation and structuring of shareholder agreements, including shareholder contracts, to regulate partner relationships within the Venezuelan company. This year, we successfully completed all steps necessary for BDO Colombia's establishment in Venezuela.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic corporate restructuring and shareholder-governance mandate for a construction company. The work includes new corporate agreements and mediation of shareholder disputes, reportedly resulting in mutual concessions that enabled business continuity; it also includes negotiation concerning a construction project. The Corporate/M&A nexus is the restructuring, governance and shareholder-resolution work; project execution is adjacent rather than the principal selection basis. Value is confidential.
matters.rationale: Selected for its documented combination of restructuring, shareholder conflict resolution and corporate agreements. The source attributes a business-continuity result to the mediated concessions, but does not provide the terms or status of the construction-project negotiations.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A department has assisted this leading construction company in Venezuela with its corporate restructuring and the development of new corporate agreements. In addition, our team has mediated various corporate disputes between its shareholders, achieving mutual concessions that have allowed the business to continue and the company to function.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing corporate reorganisation and governance redesign for Kyndryl Venezuela in connection with minimising Venezuelan operations. The team is also drafting, modifying and terminating service contracts. The Corporate/M&A nexus is reorganisation and governance; contractual work is connected but secondary. No closure or completed restructuring result is stated.
matters.rationale: Selected as a clearly framed multinational-client reorganisation and governance mandate. It is lower than the leading core matters because the source gives no detail of the structural changes, transaction value or completed result.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A department is assisting Kyndryl Venezuela, S.C.A. (Kyndryl), an American multinational provider of information technology infrastructure services, with its corporate reorganisation and the planning and modification of its corporate governance, as part of a broader strategy to minimize its operations in Venezuela.

matters.legal_understanding: In-process domestic wind-down of a General Motors affiliate, focused on outstanding vehicle-financing matters and sale of significant real estate. The Corporate/M&A nexus is corporate wind-down and asset disposal; financing and real-estate elements are adjacent components. The source does not state a completed sale, value or further transaction structure.
matters.rationale: Selected as a distinct multinational-affiliate wind-down with corporate disposal work. It is lower in the core order because the source provides limited detail on the real-estate sale process and no stated outcome.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department has been working in the process of winding down of the operations of this GM affiliate, specially related to pending financing of vehicles and the selling process of important real estate.

matters.rationale: Retained as a cross-border Corporate/M&A-department mandate concerning Domi Investment Inc.’s negotiation of a participation in a Saint Lucian company. The nature of that participation, including any instrument, percentage, commercial terms, and whether a transaction closed, is not stated; it should not be presented as an equity or capital investment.
matters.legal_understanding: ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A department assisted Domi Investment Inc. in negotiating its participation in Franchise Holdings Limited, a Saint Lucian company identified as the Master Franchise of Domino’s Pizza in Saint Lucia. The firm’s documented role is negotiation. The participation’s legal and economic character, and any completed acquisition or closing, remain unknown.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A department assisted Domi Investment Inc. in negotiating its participation in a Saint Lucian company called Franchise Holdings Limited, which is the Master Franchise of Domino's Pizza in Saint Lucia.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing wind-down of Venezuelan operations for Sedgwick International, including negotiations to terminate contracts and a director’s employment, anticipated appointment as legal representatives for closure, and Insurance Superintendency filings. The Corporate/M&A nexus is corporate closure; employment and insurance-regulatory work are mixed-practice elements. Appointment and closure completion are prospective, not completed outcomes.
matters.rationale: Selected as a defined regulated-sector closure mandate that supports the restructuring/liquidation narrative. It ranks at the end of the core set because the principal work remains in progress and contains substantial employment and regulatory components.
matters.source_quote:
ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A department is assisting the client with the wind-down of its Venezuelan operations. We are currently negotiating the termination of contracts and the director's employment.

Additionally, we will be appointed as their legal representatives to complete the closure process and handle all necessary filings with the Insurance Superintendency.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing domestic franchise-launch mandate involving company updating, supplier and employment contracts, compliance, and drafting a franchise agreement for current and future franchises. The Corporate/M&A nexus is franchise and commercial-contract structuring, but employment, supplier and compliance work are mixed-practice elements. No value, completed result or material complexity is stated.
matters.rationale: A relevant commercial expansion mandate, but it makes less marginal editorial contribution than the selected cross-border structuring, acquisition, disposal and restructuring work. It can be used if further evidence establishes the franchise structure’s scale or complexity.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department has assisted the client in establishing the first franchise of Venezuela's leading coffee chain. Our work involved updating the company, drafting contracts with suppliers and employees, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Notably, we focused on drafting the franchise agreement for this and future franchises.

matters.rationale: Retained as a reserve example of ongoing cross-border negotiation and agreement drafting for a co-owner group, with a limited Corporate/M&A connection. The source supports differences among camp owners and agreements for joint brand use, but not shareholder status, corporate structure, governance rights, negotiated ownership rights, or a definitive outcome.
matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing negotiation for the Maute Group, described as one of the owners of Camp La Llanada, in connection with differences with other camp owners. The team also negotiated and drafted agreements for the joint use of the “La Llanada” brand. This should be characterized as a co-owner and brand-use arrangement, not as a shareholder or corporate-governance dispute.
matters.source_quote:
ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A department assisted the Maute Group, one of the owners of a summer camp called Camp La Llanada, based in Venezuela, USA and Spain, in the negotiation process due to important differences with other camp owners.

The team also participated in the negotiation and drafting of agreements for the joint use of the "La Llanada" brand.

Negotiations continued in 2024.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing negotiation of an alliance agreement to provide telemedicine services in remote Venezuelan and other Latin American locations, undertaken with Fe y Alegría. The work is commercial/alliance contracting with a possible Corporate/M&A nexus, but the source does not identify a joint venture, corporate vehicle, ownership structure, jurisdictions of the agreement or execution outcome.
matters.rationale: Reserved as a socially oriented strategic-alliance mandate. It is less directly demonstrative of Corporate/M&A than the selected acquisitions, restructurings, equity work and entity formations.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department is providing legal assistance to Tomas Sanabria in the negotiation of an alliance agreement for the provision of telemedicine services in very remote areas of Venezuela and some Latin American countries. It is a joint work with Fe y Alegría, a very well-known non-profit organisation in Venezuela and some Latin American countries.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing assistance in ending a corporate relationship and the employment of a senior executive on amicable terms, with commercial and labour-law compliance. The Corporate/M&A component is termination of the corporate relationship, but the factual description does not identify the ownership, governance, transaction documents or other corporate mechanics. Employment law is a substantial mixed-practice component.
matters.rationale: Reserved rather than selected because the source supports some corporate-advisory work but does not explain the corporate relationship being terminated or establish a sufficiently substantive Corporate/M&A mandate.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Corporate and M&A Department is providing legal assistance to Financorp Consulting and Grupo Financorp, C.A. in the process of terminating the corporate relationship and the employment of a senior executive of the company on amicable terms and in compliance with commercial and labour law.

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing corporate housekeeping and aviation-regulatory compliance for air-ambulance companies, involving share-capital payment, management-regime reformulation, financial-statement approval and INAC compliance. The Corporate/M&A nexus is limited to routine governance maintenance; the principal distinctive element is sector regulation. No transaction, restructuring, financing or outcome is identified.
matters.rationale: Excluded because the supplied work is routine corporate administration and regulatory compliance, with insufficient evidence of a material corporate transaction or non-routine restructuring.
matters.source_quote: We have assisted them in the updating of corporate aspects, such as the payment of share capital, the reformulation of the management regime, the approval of financial statements, and we have assisted them in complying with regulatory issues at the National Institute of Civil Aeronautic (INAC).

matters.legal_understanding: Ongoing general corporate and institutional-relations advice to a construction-sector chamber, including contract and legislation/regulation review supporting sector programmes and information gathering. This is general advisory and policy-related work, not an identifiable Corporate/M&A transaction, restructuring, governance event or acquisition/disposal.
matters.rationale: Excluded because the source does not describe a discrete corporate mandate of the type needed for a Corporate/M&A work highlight. The client’s construction-sector role does not establish practice relevance.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA’s Corporate and M&A Department assists Cámara Venezolana de la Construcción in its corporate affairs and its relations with national and foreign institutions, including the review of contracts and legislation/regulations that involve the development of programmes and the gathering of information to determine the current state of the construction sector in Venezuela and the recovery of the construction sector.

matters.legal_understanding: An ongoing, long-running multi-practice retainer for Simmons & Simmons Solutions Limited spanning banking, capital markets, finance, arbitration, real estate, trusts, crypto assets and international contracts. The source does not identify a discrete Corporate/M&A transaction, asset, corporate legal issue, deal role or outcome. Its broad corporate label is therefore insufficient to classify it as a Corporate/M&A work highlight.
matters.rationale: Excluded from this Corporate/M&A portfolio because the evidence describes a general multidisciplinary relationship rather than a separable corporate transaction or restructuring mandate. The underlying relationship may be relevant to other practice submissions if a specific mandate is provided.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's Banking and Corporate departments have been advising Simmons & Simmons Solutions Limited every year, for almost two decades, on banking, capital markets, project finance and secured transactions, international contracts and cross-border transactions, arbitration, real estate and trusts, international private law, real and personal property, crypto assets, exchange control regulations and financing in general.

matters.legal_understanding: Completed Spain–Venezuela settlement negotiations with the Venezuelan Attorney General’s Office concerning repayment of advances after termination of an uncompleted Hidrocapital project. The firm negotiated a settlement agreement and mutual release. Although the Corporate/M&A team is named and the source gives a value of €1,000,000.00, the legal mandate is dispute resolution and settlement of a public-contract claim, not a Corporate/M&A transaction.
matters.rationale: Excluded from a Corporate/M&A selection because its direct legal subject is resolution of a contractual dispute with a public authority. The completed settlement is undisputed, but it is better classified as disputes/public-contract work.
matters.source_quote: Following Hidrocapital's decision to terminate the contract, as outlined in Administrative Provision No. 0096/2017, our firm successfully negotiated a settlement agreement and mutual release with the Attorney General's Office on behalf of Dragados, resolving the dispute over the repayment of both Bolivar and US dollar-denominated advances, including accrued interest.

matters.legal_understanding: Completed Spain–Venezuela settlement of a dispute arising from a 1999 dam construction contract, involving litigation in Venezuela and Madrid and settlement implementation through transfers, banking operations, waivers and court settlements. The stated matter value is US$10,000,000.00, while the narrative separately identifies the original construction contract as US$60,000,000.00; these are different monetary concepts and should not be conflated. The legal nexus is disputes/public-contract settlement rather than Corporate/M&A.
matters.rationale: Excluded notwithstanding its cross-border complexity and completed settlement because the mandate’s legal core is a contractual dispute and multi-forum settlement, not a corporate transaction. Any use in another practice must retain the distinction between the stated matter value and the original contract value.
matters.source_quote: ARAQUEREYNA's involvement consisted of negotiating and implementing a solution to the situation and designing a mechanism for compliance with the agreements with the Attorney General of the Republic, which led to the signing of a settlement agreement that put an end to the entire dispute. To implement the settlement, it was necessary to design and carry out transfers and banking operations for currency exchange, payment and the execution of the final contract, with the necessary waivers and settlements, both in the Courts of Madrid, Spain, and in the Supreme Court of Venezuela.

strategy.thesis: The source-backed core portfolio demonstrates direct acquisition, disposal, regulated sale, equity restructuring, cross-border entity structuring, governance and wind-down work. Gruppo Montenegro (Montenegro S.r.l.) is the strongest hero: it expressly records a completed Italy–Venezuela–UK acquisition of the Pampero brand and continuing buyer-side Venezuelan implementation. Corporación de Aceros Arequipa, Dragados, S.A., Bursagro Casa de Bolsa Agrícola, C.A. and Inversiones Palmar, S.A. provide the principal additional transaction and restructuring evidence. The portfolio deliberately excludes Dragados, S.A. (Hidrocapital) and Dragados, S.A. because their legal core is dispute settlement rather than Corporate/M&A, and excludes routine or non-discrete advisory work. The supplied official verification records ARAQUEREYNA in Band 2 for Chambers Corporate/M&A Venezuela, edition 2027; this is an observed position, not a prediction or a performance conclusion.

matter-ext-1.explanation: La adquisición completada, el trabajo poscierre y el carácter transfronterizo respaldan selección y hero.

matter-ext-3.explanation: La reestructuración, financiación, negociación con accionistas y políticas de gobierno justifican su selección.

matter-ext-4.explanation: Las liquidaciones y ventas de participaciones ejecutadas constituyen trabajo directo de reestructuración y disposición corporativa.

matter-ext-5.explanation: La selección descansa correctamente en reestructuración, acuerdos corporativos y mediación entre accionistas, no en el proyecto inmobiliario.

matter-ext-6.explanation: El diseño internacional de estructuras y los acuerdos de alianzas aportan un nexo corporativo transfronterizo defendible.

matter-ext-7.explanation: La formación de entidad y los acuerdos de accionistas respaldan la selección; se conserva correctamente la ambigüedad temporal.

matter-ext-8.explanation: El cierre corporativo y la disposición de activos sustentan la selección sin presentar la venta inmobiliaria como completada.

matter-ext-9.explanation: La reserva reconoce correctamente su contenido comercial y de franquicia, además de la limitada complejidad documentada.

matter-ext-10.explanation: La fuente describe una relación multidisciplinaria general, sin una operación corporativa concreta que justifique selección.

matter-ext-11.explanation: La venta regulada, SPA y escrow sustentan selección; la aprobación pendiente se preserva expresamente.

matter-ext-12.explanation: El cierre societario ofrece nexo corporativo suficiente, conservando como futuros el nombramiento y la culminación.

matter-ext-13.explanation: La reorganización y modificación del gobierno corporativo respaldan selección, sin inventar cierre ni cambios específicos.

matter-ext-14.explanation: La exclusión es correcta: el núcleo jurídico es la resolución de una controversia contractual pública mediante acuerdo.

matter-ext-15.explanation: La selección está prudentemente limitada a negociación de participación transfronteriza, sin inferir instrumento, porcentaje ni cierre.

matter-ext-16.explanation: La estructura estadounidense y el análisis de sanciones aportan contenido corporativo transfronterizo, manteniendo el asunto como pendiente.

matter-ext-17.explanation: La reserva distingue correctamente copropiedad y uso de marca de una controversia societaria no acreditada.

matter-ext-18.explanation: La reserva refleja un acuerdo de alianza, sin convertirlo indebidamente en joint venture o estructura societaria.

matter-ext-19.explanation: La reestructuración de capital y sus términos económicos están respaldados, preservando confidencialidad y límites del rol.

matter-ext-20.explanation: La exclusión refleja correctamente una controversia y acuerdo multijurisdiccional, diferenciando valor del asunto y contrato original.

matter-ext-21.explanation: Los términos detallados sobre capital, administración y salidas respaldan un mandato sustantivo de gobierno societario.

matter-ext-22.explanation: La exclusión es defendible porque la fuente presenta actualización societaria y cumplimiento regulatorio, sin transacción identificada.

matter-ext-23.explanation: La reserva conserva el componente corporativo, pero reconoce que faltan mecánicas societarias concretas y predomina trabajo mixto.

matter-ext-24.explanation: La fuente acredita asesoría corporativa e institucional general, no una operación, reorganización o evento societario delimitado.

matter-ext-25.explanation: La adquisición, diligencia multijurisdiccional y fusión venezolana respaldan selección; correctamente no se presume cierre.
